examples.arabic: يبقى كده اتفقنا نجهز الشنط وناخد معانا المخلل بتاعنا
examples.english: So it's agreed, we'll prepare the bags and take our snacks and our pickles with us.
examples.transliteration: Yeb2a kedah ettafa2na, negahez el shonat w nakhod ma3ana el mekhalil beta3na.

examples.arabic: قالي انه هيجيب المخلل بتاعنا معاه وانا قولتله عظيم
examples.english: He told me he would bring our special pickles with him, and I told him, "Great!"
examples.transliteration: 2ali enno haygeeb el-mekhalil beta3na ma3ah w ana 2oltelo 3azeem

examples.arabic: ماما عملت كيكة كبيرة وشوية مخلل جنب الأكل
examples.english: Mom made a big cake and some pickles next to the food.
examples.transliteration: Mama 3amalet keeka kebeera we shwayyet mekhalil ganb el akl

examples.arabic: أهلاً يا منى! الكشري بتاعنا والمخلل هتعجبك بيها.
examples.english: Welcome, Mona! Our koshary and pickles, you will like them with it.
examples.transliteration: Ahlan ya Mona! El-koshary beta'na w el-mekhallil hat'agebek beeha.

examples.arabic: قالتلي خليهم ياكلوا المخلل اللي عملته هتعجبك طعمه
examples.english: She told me, 'Let them eat the pickles I made, you will like its taste.'
examples.transliteration: 2aletly khaleehom yaklo elmekhalil elli 3amalto hat3agebek ta3mo

examples.arabic: بس احنا اصررنا ان اهم حاجة يبقى في مخلل كتير مع كل طبق بتاعنا
examples.english: But we insisted that the most important thing is to have a lot of pickles with every dish of ours.
examples.transliteration: Bas ehna asrarna en aham haga yeb2a fe mekhalil keteer ma3 kol taba2 beta3na.
examples.storyTitle: The Wedding Party and the Pickles
